entity: Tesla Fremont plant, Bay Area Air District violation notices and enforcement since 2019
what_we_add: rank: second of 86 Bay Area plants; notices written on 133 days; peers' median of 28 formal actions per 100 notices; Phillips 66 Rodeo 213 notices with no formal action
why: The notice count matches: 369 notices in five years, all pending, no fines (sources 0, 2), close to our 356. But the no-enforcement half is contradicted: KQED says the district settled with Tesla for a $1M penalty in 2021, and the district itself asked for an abatement order in 2024. A contradiction outranks the match; the federal file most likely just doesn't hold the district's 2021 settlement.
